title: Navneet Kumar Singh v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shashi Kant Gupta, J.; Piyush Agrawal, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; relegated to Clause 6.5; no coercive action for six weeks.
headnote: A consumer's writ seeking to quash an Executive Engineer demand and a subsequent meter-sealing bill was not entertained. Dispute as to correctness of the bill is to be raised under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The High Court directed a fresh application/objection within two weeks, a speaking decision after hearing within four weeks, and a limited stay of coercive action.
facts: The petitioner, a consumer of the Debai electricity distribution division, District Bulandshahr, sought certiorari to quash an Executive Engineer order dated 7 November 2019 directing payment of Rs. 37,788 and a December 2019 bill demanding Rs. 36,939 for meter sealing. Counsel submitted that after he deposited a cheque for Rs. 37,788 and the connection was restored, the respondents issued the later bill without a hearing. He disputed that demand.

holding_units.holding: A writ challenging the correctness of an electricity bill will not be entertained where Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 furnishes a statutory remedy. The consumer may file a fresh application or objection before the appropriate authority within the time allowed; that authority is to decide it by a speaking order after hearing. Coercive action is stayed for six weeks or until that decision, whichever is earlier, but the protection lapses if the consumer does not approach in time.

principle_tags.application: The Division Bench declined to entertain the writ because Clause 6.5 of the Supply Code is the statutory remedy for a disputed bill.
The Court treated the challenge to the Executive Engineer demand and the meter-sealing bill as a dispute about correctness of the bill, to be taken under Clause 6.5.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the 7 November 2019 demand of Rs. 37,788 and the December 2019 meter-sealing bill of Rs. 36,939
not_decided.note: Left to the Clause 6.5 authority on a fresh application/objection.
